parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the participation (its `id` attribute).

user.description: ID of the pro user who performs the action, from [/users](ref:users_list). Optional: when it is missing, the action is attributed to the pro user of your API token. The pro user must have access to the point of sale of the participation.

note.description: Private note about the call, for example more context about the dissatisfaction of the end customer. Optional.

rating.description: Rating of the call, integer from 1 to 5. Optional.

put.description: Records that a pro user called the end customer instead of writing a reply, with an optional private note and rating of the call. Only possible when `call` is listed in the `actions` attribute of the participation, which is the case for participations that triggered a dissatisfaction alert. See [Create your interface](doc:create-your-interface).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the participation (its `id` attribute).

put.description: Marks the participation as done without a reply: its `state` becomes `closed`. Only possible when `close` is listed in the `actions` attribute of the participation: otherwise the API returns a `400` error. See [Create your interface](doc:create-your-interface).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the participation (its `id` attribute).

user.description: ID of the pro user who performs the action, from [/users](ref:users_list). Optional: when it is missing, the action is attributed to the pro user of your API token. The pro user must have access to the point of sale of the participation.

content.description: Text of the private message sent to the end customer.

put.description: Sends a private message from a pro user to the end customer, after the participation has been processed. Only possible when the participation `state` is `closed` and `message` is listed in its `actions` attribute: otherwise the API returns a `400` error. See [Create your interface](doc:create-your-interface).

parameters.description: ID of the participation (its `id` attribute).

content.description: Text of the reply sent to the end customer.

remark_type.description: Type to give to the verbatim: `Question`, `Idea`, `Problem`, `Praise`, `Message` or `NoType`. Required when the participation is an external review (for example a Google review) whose verbatim has not been typed yet; not used otherwise.

put.description: Sends a written reply from a pro user to the end customer, as from the Goodays back office. Only possible when `reply` is listed in the `actions` attribute of the participation: otherwise the API returns a `400` error. See [Create your interface](doc:create-your-interface).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the participation (its `id` attribute).

put.description: Marks the participation as spam: its `state` becomes `spam`. A spam stays in your data and in your statistics. Only possible when `spam` is listed in the `actions` attribute of the participation: otherwise the API returns a `400` error. See [Create your interface](doc:create-your-interface).

get.description: Lists the solicitations (emails and SMS) sent for the points of sale of your perimeter, most recent first, with summary attributes. To get the status of a solicitation, use [/solicitations/{id}](ref:solicitations_read). See [Solicitation nation](doc:solicitation-nation).

place.description: Point of sale the solicitation is sent for: Place ID from [/places](ref:places_list), or your External ID.

survey.description: ID of the survey to send, from [/surveys](ref:surveys_list). The survey must be linked to the point of sale.

sender.description: For an email: `Name <no-reply@yourdomain.com>` or an email address. For an SMS: a phone number, or a sender ID of 1 to 11 characters made of letters without accents, digits and spaces.

recipient.description: Email address (type `email`) or phone number (type `sms`) of the end customer. For phone numbers, the [E.164](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-e164) format is recommended, for example `+33612345678`.

context.description: Custom parameters of the solicitation, as key/value strings: `first_name`, `last_name`, `email`, `phone`, `crm_id` and your own keys. The custom parameters marked `required` in [/configuration](ref:configuration_list) must be filled. When `email` (for an email) or `phone` (for an SMS) is missing, it is filled with `recipient`.

post.description: Sends a survey to one end customer by email or SMS. The API sends every solicitation it receives: it applies no marketing pressure rule, so it is up to you not to solicit the same end customer too often. Returns the `id` of the solicitation. See [Solicitation nation](doc:solicitation-nation).

place.description: Point of sale the solicitations are sent for: Place ID from [/places](ref:places_list), or your External ID.

type.description: `email` or `sms`, for all the solicitations of the request.

survey.description: ID of the survey to send, from [/surveys](ref:surveys_list). The survey must be linked to the point of sale.

sender.description: Sender of all the solicitations of the request. For an email: `Name <no-reply@yourdomain.com>` or an email address. For an SMS: a phone number, or a sender ID of 1 to 11 characters made of letters without accents, digits and spaces.

data.description: One object per end customer, with `recipient`, `context` and, optionally, `lang`. They follow the same rules as in [/solicitations](ref:solicitations_create).

post.description: Sends the same survey to several end customers in one request, for one point of sale, with one type (`email` or `sms`) and one sender. If one item of `data` is invalid, the whole request is rejected and nothing is sent. Returns the IDs of the solicitations (`ids`). See [Solicitation nation](doc:solicitation-nation).

post.description:
Creates a participation right away, as soon as you collected it in your own tool (kiosk, app, call center...). The participation is processed like any participation collected by Goodays, unless its survey has been set up by your Goodays project contact to feed statistics and analyses only. A `201` means the participation is recorded.

See [Become a collection source](doc:become-a-collection-source) and [Live or historical import](doc:live-vs-historical-import).

Queues a past participation for import. The payload is checked when you send it; the participation is created a few minutes later and only feeds your statistics (no Inbox, no alert, no notification). A `201` means the participation is accepted in the queue.

See [Legacy retrieval](doc:legacy-retrieval) and [Live or historical import](doc:live-vs-historical-import).

user.description: ID of the pro user who performs the action, from [/users](ref:users_list). Optional: when it is missing, the action is attributed to the pro user of your API token. The pro user must have access to the point of sale of the participation.

remark_type.description: Type to give to the verbatim: `Question`, `Idea`, `Problem`, `Praise`, `Message` or `NoType`. Required when the participation is an external review (for example a Google review) whose verbatim has not been typed yet; not used otherwise.

date.description: Date of the participation of the end customer (ISO 8601, for example `2020-08-07T01:29:30+02:00`). Cannot be in the future.

user.description: The end customer: `email`, `first_name` (both mandatory if the object is sent), `last_name`, `phone`, `crm_id`. Mandatory to send a verbatim.

context.description: Your custom parameters, as key/value pairs. Get the keys from [/configuration](ref:configuration_list).

place.description: Place ID or External ID of the point of sale.

answers.description: List of answers: `{"question": "<question ID>", "value": <value>}`. Can be empty when you only send a verbatim.

medium.description: Collection channel of the participation, for example `TE` (transactional email), `TS` (transactional SMS) or `MOB` (mobile). Ask your Goodays project contact for yours.

message.description: Verbatim of the end customer: `created_date`, `type` (`Idea`, `Praise`, `Problem`, `Question` or `NoType`) and `content`. Requires `user` and `survey`.

collect_uid.description: Your unique identifier for the participation. If it already exists for your account, the participation is rejected with a `409`.

last_login.description: Date and time of the user's last login to Goodays (null if the user never logged in).

interface_moderation.description: Access to the moderation of the reviews published on your store displays.
